overal.goal: `worktree.root` (a global setting, or a per-project override set at project create or update) tells boof where `git worktree add` puts task worktrees. A client with `settings:write` or `projects:write` can point it at any directory the server user can write, so boof creates directories (and checks out repository contents) outside every allowed project root. For non-local principals, limit `worktree.root` to `security.allowedProjectRoots`: resolve it with `resolveUnbornPath` (the deepest existing ancestor through `realpath`, so a symlink or `..` cannot lead out), refuse `/`, the home directory and the data root, and answer `403 project_root_not_allowed`. Check it in `settings.update`, `projects.create` and `projects.update`, and again when the worktree is created (the same re-check on the real path that `ProjectStore.create` does with `assertTarget`). The local principal is unchanged.
overal.stack: TypeScript monorepo (Node 22 / Bun), Hono, zod, vitest

rules.do: Read README.md, docs/boof-runner.md (worktrees, security) and goals/project-create-with-path/goal.boof.xml for how allowed roots are enforced for new project directories (resolveUnbornPath, assertTarget) before changing code.
Write a failing test first, then make it pass; keep the change focused on this goal. Cover a symlinked ancestor, a `..` segment, a not-yet-existing root and the home directory.
Run `npm run typecheck && npm test` and `npm run lint` before finishing.
rules.dont: Do not change public API or MCP shapes without updating docs/api.md and the OpenAPI document.
Do not commit secrets, data roots or build output.
